findings.description: find_matching_orders compares every order against every other order in a nested loop, giving O(n^2) growth as the order list grows.
findings.suggested_action: Index orders by customer_id in a dict before the loop and look up matches in O(1) per order, reducing the pass to O(n) overall.

findings.description: apply_discounts recomputes the full discount table for every order item even though the table depends only on the order's tier.
findings.suggested_action: Hoist the discount-table computation out of the per-item loop and cache it per tier for the duration of the call.
